test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 24 Aug 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Vishal is standing in a park facing the south direction. He then turns 90° clockwise on the same point. After that, he turns 45° clockwise. In which direction is he facing now?
solution:
According to the given information,

1) Vishal is standing in a park facing the south direction.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c21c880236c60caea5545fcaf9bcd71506c4c97434e3c14bb9f0af0f8622b5d3.png] 

2) He then turns 90° clockwise on the same point.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e6132640db507f9edae820aa38edcdbe74e0b4b0c746659ff4fc88865e0af09c.png] 

3) After that, he turns 45° clockwise.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bb558a5134627b58f80770343c698836e64d5eca080d23b279cd04b8cde506e7.png] 

Here, we can see that he is now facing North - west direction.

Hence, the correct answer is **"****North - west"**.
